visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a black ceramic pot containing braised pork belly and hard-boiled eggs in a dark, shimmering sauce. Steam rises from the hot dish as a pair of metal chopsticks gently pokes one of the meat pieces. The setting is a clean, modern kitchen with a light-colored countertop. (2) The scene cuts to a silver Sharp microwave oven. The door is opened to reveal several chunks of raw, pink-and-white marbled pork belly arranged on a dark plate inside. White text appears on the screen. (3) Chunks of pork belly are being seared in a black pan along with sliced ginger. A hand uses metal tongs to flip the meat, which is turning golden brown. Sizzling oil is visible. (4) Dark soy sauce is poured into the pan, and the meat is stirred with tongs until it is evenly coated and takes on a rich brown color. (5) Water is added along with long stalks of green scallions and more ginger. A hand places a tan, textured ceramic lid onto the pot. The pot sits on an induction cooktop showing a digital display. (6) The lid is lifted to show the liquid boiling vigorously around the pork and scallions. (7) Later in the cooking process, the lid is lifted again to reveal that the sauce has reduced and several peeled, hard-boiled eggs have been added to the pot. The meat appears much darker and tender. (8) The final sequence shows a piece of the braised pork belly being held up by metal chopsticks, wobbling to demonstrate its soft texture. The background remains the bubbling pot of stew.

(6) [Subtitle]: 煮滾之後 轉小火燉煮1小時. (7) [Subtitle]: 加蛋之後再煮30分鐘. (8) [Subtitle]: 好軟爛 好好吃 🤤. (9) [Subtitle]: 冬天配飯 超適合. (10) [Subtitle]: 孩子都說好好吃.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat Japanese pop music with female vocals and a driving electronic beat begins. The music is bright and high-arousal. (2) A sharp mechanical click and sliding sound are heard as the microwave door opens. The music continues at a consistent volume. (3) A loud, high-frequency sizzling sound begins, representing meat hitting hot oil. This sound is layered clearly over the background music. (4) The sizzling shifts to a wetter, lower-frequency bubbling sound as soy sauce and water are poured in. (5) A distinct ceramic-on-ceramic clink is heard as the lid is placed on the pot. The background sizzling/bubbling becomes muffled. (6) A sharp scraping and clinking sound occurs as the lid is lifted again. The wet bubbling sound of the stew becomes louder and more prominent. (7) The video concludes with the music continuing its rhythmic loop while the bubbling sound remains as a texture in the background mix.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a concise, step-by-step culinary tutorial for making braised pork belly in a ceramic pot. It uses a combination of appetizing visual close-ups and on-screen instructional text to guide the viewer through defrosting, searing, seasoning, and simmering the dish. The upbeat Japanese BGM and the 'wobble' test of the meat at the end are designed to evoke a sense of homey warmth and high-quality results.
